newsitem.title: USA: Greenfield to buy back up to 1.25 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Greenfield to buy back up to 1.25 mln shrs.

text.p: Greenfield Industries Inc said Thursday it authorized repurchase up to 1,250,000 shares of its common stock.
The repurchases may be made from time-to-time in the open market or in negotiated or other permissible transactions, the company said.
As of March 21, 1997, there were 16,398,257 shares of common stock outstanding, the company said.
Greenfield said the purchase of the shares will be made from available cash flow and from existing debt facilities.
After giving effect to the contemplated repurchase, the company said it expects its cash flow and debt capacity will be adequate to finance future acquisitions.
